verdict.rationale: Pydantic AI is an agent framework with hosted companions (AI Gateway, Logfire), so a training opt-out or no-training data guarantee is a fair question to ask. The evidence pack contains nothing about training-data use, opt-outs, data retention or no-training guarantees. Model-agnostic provider choice is at most an adjacent user-side workaround, not the product's own capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can prevent my data from being used to train AI models
